t: Robust twin pack comprising 5m tape measure and 250mm torpedo level. Tape measure with 27mm wide nylon-wrapped blade, double-sided with yellow top face and white bottom face to aid visibility. Features strong, embedded magnets, V-groove for fastening on metal such as copper pipe, rounded belt clip, slide lock and finger brake mechanism. Offers standout of up to 2.8m. High-accuracy torpedo level with Vertisite technology allows easy reading of a side vial when viewed from the front. Ideal for confined spaces or when reaching out to a surface. Features removable shock-absorbing end caps, small feet to help avoid surface marking, zero-point correct end hook with strong magnets, and vial lines made with embedded wire.
